name: FacetGuard SEO
author: Mateusz Maciejczyk

sections.description:
FacetGuard SEO helps WooCommerce stores keep filtered, sorting and tracking URLs under control.

A separate Pro version is available outside WordPress.org: Buy FacetGuard SEO Pro

Features included in the WordPress.org Lite plugin:
– safe robots + canonical handling for faceted URLs
– configurable facet / ignore / keep parameter rules
– dry-run URL Analyzer
– SEO Check for real-output validation
– logs and diagnostics export
sections.installation:
1. Upload facetguard-seo to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin
  3. Go to FacetGuard SEO → Settings
sections.changelog:
0.7.14

  • Cleaned the WordPress.org Lite build so it ships as a fully functional free plugin.
